prompt: A car drives $240$ miles on $8$ gallons of gas. How far can it go on $15$ gallons at the same rate?
hint: The car gets the same distance out of every gallon. Find how far a single gallon takes it.

hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Use the gallons you already know about: $8$ gallons take the car $240$ miles, so how far would $16$ gallons take it? Your answer for $15$ gallons should be a little less.
The car gets the same distance out of every gallon. Find how far a single gallon takes it.
The car goes $240 \div 8 = 30$ miles on one gallon. Multiply that by $15$ gallons.
$30 \times 15 = 450$, so the car can go $450$ miles on $15$ gallons.

explanation: Find the unit rate first: $240 \div 8 = 30$ miles per gallon.
Each of the $15$ gallons gives another $30$ miles, so multiply $30 \times 15$.
Work it out in parts: $30 \times 10 = 300$ and $30 \times 5 = 150$, and $300 + 150 = 450$.
The car can travel $450$ miles on $15$ gallons.
